what: A vertical ruler (fine tick every 8px, long tick every 10) lies faintly across the page, and as the scroll ratio u rises, bright ticks fill from the top up to d + (0.15u + 0.85u³)(0.5 − d) — slow at first, then fast near the end, up to about halfway. A 40px line and a label attach at the filled end and follow it down, and the label’s value slot shows the distance scrolled so far in cm·m (1m = 3779.53px) is written. When the comparison text changes, it fades out and back over .25s

options.step: Small grid spacing (px), default 8 — 4 for phone original
options.every: Number of cells per long tick, default 10
options.reach: Height reached when fully lowered (share of the ruler height), default .5
options.[data-fx-part=tag]: (If present) Tag following the filled end
options.[data-fx-part=value]: (if present) place to write the distance dropped — inside the tag
options.[data-fx-part=note]: (If present) data-at="0.5 1 2" Like m-unit threshold and data-say="…|…|…" Copy — changes in .25s at the threshold crossed

use: So far

from.where: shared.js footer .tw-ruler — desktop step 8 · major 20 · minor 10, phone step 4 · major 11 · minor 5.5
